author: Telegram and/or TON Core (maybe)
description: Source code reconstructed by @ai_terminal. Buyer-funded offer for one NFT from one seller: pays the price and a marketplace fee on sale; the buyer can cancel, paying a fee before expiry; a signed or post-expiry external cancel refunds the buyer

fields.name: prevOwner
fields.description: Owner before the transfer. The offer pays this address when it is the seller.

declarations.name: NftTransfer

fields.name: responseDestination
fields.description: Gets the excess of the transfer value.

declarations.description:
TEP-62 `transfer`: owner → NFT item. The offer sends it with no custom payload, no forward
amount and an empty inline forward payload.

declarations.name: CancelByBuyer
declarations.description:
Buyer → offer: closes the offer in any phase and sends the balance to the buyer. Before
expiry, a cancel fee goes to the fee address first.

declarations.name: CancelOffer

fields.name: signature
fields.description:
Ed25519 signature by the offer key over the hash part of the offer address. Required
before expiry; null works only after expiry. A replay does nothing, because the offer is
then no longer Active.

declarations.description: External cancel of an Active offer. Sends the balance to the buyer and closes the offer.

declarations.name: Phase

members.name: Funding
members.description: Deployed; waits for the buyer to fund the price, the fee and the storage reserve.

members.name: Active
members.description: Funded; accepts the NFT from the seller until expiry.

members.name: Sold
members.description:
The seller got the price and the NFT transfer to the recipient was sent. If the NFT item
rejects that transfer, the NFT stays with the offer.

members.name: Closed
members.description: Cancelled by the buyer, cancelled with the offer key, or cancelled after expiry.

declarations.description:
Offer lifecycle. Offers are deployed in `Funding`, and the contract sets every later phase.
The contract doesn't check the deployed phase; indexers recognise only an address whose
state init has `Funding`.

declarations.name: Parties

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Funds the offer and gets the balance back on a cancel.

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: Gets the NFT after a sale.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: The only previous owner whose NFT the offer buys.

declarations.description: Addresses that take part in the offer.

fields.name: feeAddress
fields.description:
Gets the cancel fee, the excess of the NFT transfer, and the rest of the balance after a
sale: the funded fee and any surplus.

fields.name: feeBps
fields.description: Fee in basis points of the price, which the buyer funds on top of the price.

fields.name: cancelFee
fields.description:
Sets the fee for a buyer cancel before expiry: the larger of this value in basis points
of the price and a minimum fee that is proportional to this value.

declarations.name: OfferConfig

fields.name: nft
fields.description: The NFT item the offer buys.

fields.name: salt
fields.description: Any value. It makes the offer address unique.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description:
Unix time from which the offer no longer accepts funding or the NFT. From then on, a buyer
cancel has no fee and an external cancel needs no signature.

declarations.description: Offer terms. They don't change after deployment.

declarations.name: Storage

fields.name: publicKey
fields.description: Ed25519 key that can cancel the offer with an external before expiry.

declarations.description: Contract data. Only `phase` changes after deployment.

get_methods.name: nftOfferData
get_methods.description: Full offer storage: the config cell, the offer key and the phase.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotEnoughFunds
thrown_errors.description: The funding doesn't cover the price, the fee and the storage reserve.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidOwnershipAssigned
thrown_errors.description:
`ownership_assigned` didn't come from the offer NFT, or names a previous owner outside the
basechain.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.Forbidden
thrown_errors.description: Unknown opcode (a text comment included), wrong sender, wrong phase or bad signature.
